Messages.Author: Madzar
Messages.Body:
"Cryptic Rider
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 1 blood
Only usable on a successful referendum.
The next referendum a vampire you control calls this turn passes automatically."

If the next political action is blocked does this effect remain active for the third political action in the current turn?

Thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: kombainas
Messages.Body:
If political action is blocked, referendum does not happen...

Sabbat. If this vampire's bleed is successful, he laughs manicly and untaps.
